purpose: Test actual free-root leg-driven body retreat under original Goose04 hardware before extending heavy-cart dragging; no fixed-torso neck motion as substitute.
parent: cart_drag_probe_006 closed4/4/6424; offline full_body_readiness and ingress_geometry_review retained separately

source_cart.scope: Loaded variant only, actual free box/cargo and unbound cart. Original004 not overwritten.

offline_input.qualification: Offline double-stance IK/static LP only, not prior dynamic gait success. Old Move receipts fail backward behavior.

action_program: One second actual free-root settling / loaded grip preparation plus10s joint-target program: lower body20mm, leg-driven body-back20mm, hold2s, return. Robot root and feet never fixed or controlled by state writes. Only18 joint targets through original adapter.

controller.qualification: Predeclared Teacher variant, unvalidated dynamic realization of a static torque distribution. Original controller gains, drive caps, slew, torque-speed22.2V derating,350W positive mechanical budget and disabled peaks remain. Record nominal request, bias, actual target, actual torque/speed each step.
controller.loaded_target: New007 wrapper anchors requested TCP to actual cold rod plus planned20mm backward world trajectory; do not cancel traction by unconditionally chasing actual rod. Actual rod used for monitoring/grip feedback. Frozen readiness provider retained.

trial_priority: First unloaded true-free-root double-stance11s segment with predeclared staticLP bias. Actual root/body motion, not TCP movement, decides the gate.

Only after unloaded gate passes: same segment with real20kg cargo+7.815kg cart and declared cold physical clamp initialization. This is not a full approach/grasp demonstration. Original passive k20Nm/rad,qref.0276930475 fixture and nominal8N wheel-friction cap are explicit experimental assumptions.

At most one additional targeted correction or matched unloaded/loaded repeat. If unloaded fails, spend remaining attempt only on a justified bounded control correction, not loaded trials or new gait development. Do not automatically use all attempts.

unloaded_gate.meaning: Exploratory20mm free-root body-retreat control only, not alternating gait or0.5m drag acceptance.

loaded_evaluation: Separately record true root and cart/cargo backward displacement, actual rod force, grip retention, stance slip and continuous torques. No predeclared success if only neck retracts, cart is pre-pushed, or non-rod contacts do the work. Initial holding may be cold-prepared but no robot-object binding. Tongue load, grip internal force and non-rod contacts must be measured;0/8/20N offline LP did not include all of these.
invariants: All original hardware MCI, joints, actuator contracts, collision geometry/filter rules and physical timestep. Preserve200Hz drive/physics and50Hz commands.

A single declared cold reset may initialize free-root pose and passive mechanical coordinates. After start, live qpos/qvel are read-only except the physical integrator; FK/IK scratch state is separate.
No torso/foot fixture, root force, object teleport, suction, weld to robot, robotic pose projection, or additional robot-object constraint. Existing internal mouth loop retained.
No random friction lowering. Foot-ground original effective assumption .65; wheel resistance and spring assumptions reported separately and not real-material qualification.
No PPO, GPU, ONNX policy recovery or long gait project.
abort: Preserve failures and stop on NaN/drive contract breach, tilt>25deg, loss of intended support, stance-foot slip>5mm, significant unexplained initial penetration>.5mm or unexpected non-rod pre-push. Numerical closure/penetration and IK tracking errors separately report; allow only declared initial settling, never silently change criteria.
measurements: Pre-state aligned actual contacts and6D forces, sole normal/tangent/CoP and material slip, root pose/velocity and COM, true cart/cargo and rod poses, grip/native pad versus shell/shaft, all actual drive outputs/limits, positive mechanical power, closure and penetration, warnings, thread/RSS/resource receipts; continuous original-speed video.
exit: Return by deadline with finite achieved scope and next hardware/control question. Failed controller does not prove hardware torque insufficient. No automatic renewal, no claim maximum mass, sustained rating, full grasp,0.5m walking, cross-engine or real-world acceptance.
